# Sept 2010 Bulletin: FY2010 deficit projected (MSR estimate) widened to $1.4 trillion
projected_msr_2010 = 1.4  # trillion, from "The federal budget deficit widened to $1.4 trilli[on]"

# Sept 2011 Bulletin: actual FY2010 deficit = $1.3 trillion
actual_2010 = 1.3  # trillion, "The federal budget deficit narrowed to $1.3 trillion ... in fiscal year 2010"

diff = round(abs(projected_msr_2010 - actual_2010), 2)
print(diff)
